finding: Gboard showed a clipboard paste-suggestion chip (the current host clipboard item; Gboard's clipboard history had been cleared by the human before the run) above the focused SearchBar in 3 of 66 distinct F6 frames, all in the R02 full-list clear step. The chip text is absent from all UI XML, logs, receipts, the checkpoint, the run stream and the run directory (text search of every non-PNG file found none of it). Each frame's raw screenshot receipt was byte-identical to its PNG and is redacted with it. capture-index.json, commands.jsonl and the receipts keep the executor's pre-redaction hashes; sha256After below is authoritative for the committed files.
detection: Coordinator visual inspection of all 66 distinct F6 frames via 6 contact sheets. Every other SearchBar-focused frame (F6-R02-focused, F6-R02-cleared, F6-R02-results, F6-R03-*, F6-R02-full-list-scroll-*) shows only the floating Gboard toolbar or the query with no clipboard content. All 107 raw *.stdout.bin screenshot receipts in f-device3 were byte-compared with the saved PNGs; only the three listed here matched a chip frame.
originals: Unredacted originals were moved outside version control to the git-ignored /_backup_ns07_redaction/f-device3/ folder (*.unredacted.png, *.unredacted.stdout.bin); they are never committed.
